# DeepEval

> Open-source LLM evaluation framework by Confident AI. Supports RAG, agents,
  chatbots, and virtually any LLM use case with 50+ research-backed metrics.

## Getting Started

- [Quick Introduction](https://deepeval.com/docs/getting-started): Install DeepEval and run your first LLM test
- [AI Agents](https://deepeval.com/docs/getting-started-agents): Setup LLM tracing and test end-to-end task completion
- [Chatbots](https://deepeval.com/docs/getting-started-chatbots): Setup multi-turn test cases and evaluate conversations
- [RAG](https://deepeval.com/docs/getting-started-rag): Evaluate RAG end-to-end and test retriever/generator separately
- [MCP](https://deepeval.com/docs/getting-started-mcp): Getting started with Model Context Protocol evaluations
- [LLM Arena](https://deepeval.com/docs/getting-started-llm-arena): Compare LLM outputs head-to-head
